prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Star, of the Hydrogen Nation — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a fae ball costume cut as a sharply tailored short jacket over matching shorts or a mini skirt — a wing-shaped satin trim and a leaf mask — in charcoal grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — strong light from behind passes through the thin outer fabric, so the outline of her figure shows as a soft silhouette inside it; the inner layer stays fully opaque, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small screwdriver at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

observations: Single adult woman; identity and painterly finish retained; image inspected.
